en: Huh? A couple of kids!? Are they lost{SAUT}or something?
I'm not so sure about that―something{SAUT}seems off about simply calling them{SAUT}lost kids.
What the―?
Where is our master?
Justine! Look!
So, you're here as well, Inmate.
Hey, Inmate, where are we!? What are{SAUT}you doing here!?
No idea.{OPTION}That's my line.{OPTION}Take a guess.
That look on your face... It seems you{SAUT}truly don't know.
How dare you!?
Hold, Caroline.{PAGE}That look on his face... It seems he truly{SAUT}doesn't know.
Is this your doing!?
Hold, Caroline. I doubt such a simple{SAUT}prisoner would be capable of that.{PAGE}Most likely, he himself knows nothing{SAUT}of this.
Then... what happened?
I do not know.
Ooooh, what little cutiiiies! And{SAUT}they're TWINS!?
, you know these rugrats?
Rugrats!?
Such blasphemy...
Yeah, that's right! Quit being so rude{SAUT}and show them some respect!
You know them too?{OPTION}Talk about a betrayal...
No, that's not it, but... I-It just feels right?
At any rate, tell us of your circumstances{SAUT}here, Inmate.
We'll listen to what you have to say in{SAUT}this room here―Hey, you! Cat!
Y-Yes!?
Escort the prisoner into our room.{SAUT}And make it snappy!
Wh-Why me?
I-I'll do it... Of course! With{SAUT}pleasure!
Hmph―don't forget the rest of those{SAUT}people as well.
I guess we're "the rest of those{SAUT}people"...
Seriously, who are they?{PAGE}And Morgana, why're you takin' their{SAUT}orders?
I bet he's fallen in love.{OPTION}He's like their hired cat.
Whoa, for real? Which one?
Don't be ridiculous! My love is only{SAUT}for Lady Ann!
I keep telling you, I am NOT a cat!{PAGE}*sigh* Are you happy now? I'm starting{SAUT}to get real tired of this repartee...
But that's, like, your trademark{SAUT}gag now!
...Those two have something{SAUT}"unwavering" within them.{PAGE}When they look at me with those eyes,{SAUT}I get this feeling that I just have to listen{SAUT}to them.
Like a kind of hypnosis?{OPTION}Are you losing it?
No, nothing like that. It's more like{SAUT}there's something deep in my core...{PAGE}This feeling that screams, "I have to do{SAUT}what they say!" wells up inside me...
Nothing like that wells up in me...
Well, it does for me! And, I have no idea{SAUT}why...
If they're acquaintances of {f 6 1 30 0 0 0},{SAUT}I believe we can trust them.
It'll be fine. C'mon―can't make them wait.
